prohibited_inferences: Do not treat the v10 extension or PC-12 fixture as evidence about a named deliberative process or institution.
Do not infer private preference from a public vote under conformity strategic exchange or visible majority pressure.
Do not infer a ballot or consensus from a facilitator or model-generated summary.
Do not infer reciprocal deliberation from information exposure speaking opportunity transcript volume or one-way briefing.
Do not infer reason uptake from a response unless the uptake rejection or changed disposition is preserved.
Do not infer collective agreement from amendment or majority support without a binding disposition and enforcement rule.
Do not infer public authorization from reason-responsive deliberation or participant satisfaction.
Do not infer manipulation intent legitimacy or public injury from conformity strategic exchange or summary distortion alone.
Do not treat the twelve-control floor as exhaustive of every epistemic constitutional social or performative failure mode.

interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A compositional successor floor that preserves the qualified eleven-control v9 base and adds PC-12 deliberative reason exchange vote and summary equifinality without rewriting the frozen base controls.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A real-world deliberation finding consensus verdict collective-agreement finding public-authorization verdict named-institution allegation or complete universal theory of reason-responsive collective preference formation.
interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: Preference Custody floor v10 composes the qualified v9 controls with PC-12. It separates independent conversion reciprocal reason exchange one-way briefing public conformity strategic logroll and summary distortion under one published majority, while requiring real cases to preserve participant turn reason evidence uptake proposal private-preference ballot summary counterfactual consequence and authority custody.
